title: Characterisation and properties of metahalloysite-based geopolymer composites with micro/nano-Fe3O4 contents: effect of the mixing procedure
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15963-15978
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01146B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rodrigue Cyriaque Kaze, Joël Donkeng-Dazie, Abdolhossein Naghizadeh, Mohend Chaouche
In this study, the effects of micro- and nano-sized iron powders, as well as the mixing procedure, on the fresh and hardened properties of metahalloysite-based geopolymer composites were investigated.
